notes.title: Combat 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The long awaited combat update!!![/h1][p][/p][h3]Thank you all for your suggestions contributing to this update, and feel free to watch the attached video for more details on everything added.

[/h3][previewyoutube="wIdvab-DJbo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Total Materials QOL Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a total empire material counter that shows the combined amount of each resource across all supply hubs
[*] Introduced loading screen tips to provide helpful info while the game loads
[*] The game now automatically zooms to your empire when joining a world for easier orientation
[/list]

notes.title: Squad Vehicles & Infrastructure Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the sector bug that caused issues when moving between sectors.
[*] Fixed all other known bugs for improved performance and stability.
[/list]
[h2]New Feature – Infrastructure Upgrades:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now spend gold to upgrade buildings with new infrastructure options.
[*] These upgrades add unique features to buildings and improve their capabilities.
[/list]
[h2]Truck Garage:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buildings with the Truck Garage upgrade will send squads out in military trucks.
[*] Trucks move faster than ground troops.
[*] The speed bonus only applies when squads leave a building with the garage upgrade.
[/list]
[h2]Helipad:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buildings with the Helipad upgrade deploy squads in helicopters.
[*] Helicopters move even faster than trucks.
[*] The speed bonus only applies when squads leave a building with a helipad.
[*] This update adds more strategic depth to how you manage movement and upgrades.
[/list]

notes.title: Squads Levels Patch 1
notes.notes:
New Features: 
- Squad Levels
- Squad Merging
- Power Scaling based on Squad level and size
- Squad Sizes
- Research to buy higher level squads

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed some buildings not loading in dense areas
- Finally Fixed the Stupid Squad Marker Bug

notes.title: Multi Select Squads Patch 1
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Select Multiple Squads
- Move around Multiple Squads
- Raid Buildings with multiple squads selected

- Added Squad Health
- Added Squad Size

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed floating squad tag bug
- Fixed infinite loading in multiplayer matches
